_note: Ephemeral demo -> PVC -> mount -> write -> restart -> persist, then the Block PVC challenge. PVCs omit storageClassName so the cluster default class binds. CRC-specific realities: (1) the default class is WaitForFirstConsumer, so the PVC binds only after the consumer Pod is deployed — deploy first, then check Bound; (2) because hello-dcs runs non-root (UID 1001) and a provisioned volume is root-owned, the workshop manifest now bakes in the Pod securityContext.fsGroup=1001 so the non-root app can write the volume — this is the permission fix (the write step used to fail with 'Permission denied'). NOTE: this validates the mechanism but not every real-DCS storage class's permission behaviour — validate restricted-v2 + File/NFS CSI write on DCS.

steps.run: oc create deployment hello-dcs --image="$DCS_REGISTRY/samples/hello-dcs:1.0" && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=150s
oc exec deploy/hello-dcs -- sh -c 'echo written-inside-the-container > /opt/app-root/src/note && cat /opt/app-root/src/note'
oc delete pod -l app=hello-dcs && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=150s

envsubst < hello-dcs-with-volume.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc patch deployment/hello-dcs --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/imagePullPolicy","value":"Always"}]' && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=150s
oc rollout restart deploy/hello-dcs && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=120s
